subject: Service continuity: mitigation plan and commercial path for renewal
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia@olivetech.ai>

Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Unplanned tail-latency spikes impacting inferencing — need immediate plan

Hi Karthik,

Over the past 48 hours we've observed repeated tail-latency spikes on several production routes that power our recommendation API. The spikes correlate with peak batch traffic and have caused 3 customer-facing incidents (users received timeouts) and ~7% increased error rate during the 17:00–19:30 UTC window on 2026-07-27. We've opened ticket #OT-1129 and attached a short screenshot of the latency distribution.

This is putting our renewal conversation at risk; we had planned to move to a 12-month committed path next month but the execs are asking for concrete mitigations and commercial protections before sign-off (SLA, credits, or a safer migration path). Can you propose an immediate remediation plan and the commercial levers Redwood can offer to preserve our deal momentum? Procurement (procure@olivetech.ai) is copied — they will want a clear statement of remedies.

Attachment: latency_spikes_2026-07-27.png (PNG, 320KB)

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Head of ML Platforms
OliveTech

Subject: Re: Unplanned tail-latency spikes impacting inferencing — need immediate plan

Thanks for flagging this, Olivia — really sorry for the disruption. We take reliability concerns seriously and I want to get a concrete, time-bound plan on your table today.

Proposed next steps:
- Quick async triage: we'll pull detailed telemetry for the affected routes and share an annotated timeline within 6 hours.
- Short-term mitigations (hours): enable aggressive KV caching on the recommendation routes and route-priority bumping to avoid contention during peak windows.
- Medium-term (2–3 weeks): pilot a dedicated capacity slice for the recommendation route with an isolation guard.
- Commercial: we'll prepare a proposal that includes a one-time service credit and a scoped SLA uplift for the pilot period.

I've looped in Laura (CS lead) and Priyom (solutions) to scope the MAP and commercial ask. Please confirm a 30-minute sync at 11:00 PT today or suggest another slot. Attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (redline_map_v1.xlsx) to speed alignment.

Attachment: redline_map_v1.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)

Best,

From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: OliveTech - triage recap and commercial options

Team — quick summary from the triage this morning (notes from the call and telemetry):
- Cause: contention in shared GPU pools when cold KV cache misses align with 8–12 token prompts; worst during 17:00–19:30 UTC.
- Impact: transient tail latency spike to ~2.4s p95 on route, customer-facing timeouts for specific low-latency SLAs.

Commercial levers I recommend we surface to OliveTech:
1) Short credit + commitment swap: offer a one-time service credit (~5% of last invoice) on receipt of a signed 6-month committed capacity amendment.
2) Pilot dedicated slice: 8-week dedicated pilot with preferential pricing and a scoped 99.95% uptime SLA on the specific recommendation route. Pilot priced as a discounted reserved capacity plug-in.
3) Rapid engineering fixes: prioritize KV pre-warm, prioritized request routing, and temporary batching caps. No cost to OliveTech for the engineering effort.

Numbers: if they commit to a 6-month reserved commitment at ~60% of their projected usage, our estimated revenue uplift covers the pilot and credit over the contract term. I put a simple calc in service_credit_calc.csv.

Ask: approve option 2 (pilot + scoped SLA) and permission to include a 5% one-time credit in the commercial package. If yes, I'll present to Olivia and loop legal/procurement for an amendment.

Karthik
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@olivetech.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, procure@olivetech.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed remediation + commercial path (pilot + scoped SLA)

Hi Olivia — thanks again for the call last week. Following internal triage and the options we discussed, here's a compact proposal to keep your renewal on track while we eliminate the tail spikes: 

1) Immediate (hours): we will enable KV pre-warming and apply a temporary request-priority policy for your recommendation routes. Expected p95 improvement: 35–50% during peak.

2) Pilot (8 weeks): dedicated capacity slice sized to your peak 99th percentile with scoped 99.95% uptime SLA on the recommendation route. Pilot includes monthly operational reviews and a post-pilot rollback/fallback plan.

3) Commercial and credits: on execution of a 6-month reserved capacity amendment we will provide a one-time credit equal to 5% of the trailing 3-month spend, applied on the first invoice after amendment. If pilot meets SLA targets, customer can convert to committed capacity at the pilot pricing.

Attachments: redline_map_v1.xlsx; service_credit_calc.csv

Next steps: if this package looks acceptable, please confirm and we'll:
- Draft an amendment (MSA addendum + SOW for the pilot) and route to your procurement via DocuSign.
- Kick off pilot onboarding within 72 hours of signed amendment.

Karthik — thank you for the clear plan and fast turnaround. OliveTech is prepared to proceed with the 8-week dedicated pilot and the 6-month reserved amendment contingent on:
- The scoped 99.95% uptime being explicitly limited to the named recommendation route in the amendment.
- The one-time 5% credit to be reflected in the amendment and applied on the first invoice after execution.
- A clear rollback/fallback plan and an SLA verification test in week 2 of the pilot.

Please send the revised amendment and DocuSign link to procure@olivetech.ai. Our legal team will review but we expect to sign quickly if the doc reflects the items above. We appreciate the engineering support and look forward to getting stability back.
